title: He Gave Up The Exam To Save A Drowning Girl, Then Lost A Duel . . . (Part 2)
caption:
Airen Farreira dove into a lake mid-exam to save Judith in The Lazy Lord Masters the Sword.
The lazy lord is mocked, wins respect, and loses a duel to a noble. Follow for part 3!

#thelazylordmasterstheSword #manhwarecap #manhwa #webtoon #fyp
credit: The Lazy Lord Masters the Sword (Dodomoon / Doip / Second Star)
comment: Would you save Judith like Airen, or finish the exam like Illia wanted? Why? 👀 Comment below 👇

segments.say: Airen throws away the whole exam to haul a drowning girl out of the *lake*.
To see how it got here, go back to the day of the *midterm*.
Lloyd smirks like the win is already his, but Judith looks like a *wreck*.
Ahmed explains the course. Four stages, lifting, jumping, running and *swimming*.
Then Ahmed yells go, and Illia clears the lifting stage before anyone else can *blink*.
Second name called is Airen Farreira, and Lloyd can't *believe* it. Main-character energy.
Stage two is box jumping, and Airen's body burns, but for once he doesn't feel *tired*.
Ahmed's jaw drops, and the old sword master just *smiles*.
Stage three is a long run, and Judith sprints behind them like a Naruto-runner on *fire*.
Stage four is a swim across the lake, but Judith's legs cramp, and the water *swallows* her.
Airen sees her go under, and the exam stops *mattering*. He dives in after her.
She coughs up half the lake, and a trainer tells Airen to leave the rest to him and *go*.
Airen finishes thirty-fourth of thirty-five, and the whole yard calls him the *hero* of the day.
Lloyd takes second place, and quietly admits he could never catch *Illia*.
The next day Illia corners Airen. He threw away a reward from the greatest sword master on the continent, for a *girl*.
Airen only smiles. He says his family pulled him out of a *swamp* once, so he couldn't walk past someone drowning.
Illia goes cold. She says she won't help him *anymore*, and walks away.
At the results, the sword master stops everything and calls *Airen* to the podium.
He tells the whole hall Airen saved a colleague from drowning, and the hall breaks into *applause*.
Lloyd visits the sword master first, and admits he was *arrogant*.
Then Illia asks for his personal guidance as her reward, but the old man tells her to go home. She storms *out*.
Now it's Airen's turn, and the sword master asks what reward he wants. Airen has no *idea*.
The old man knows Airen never left his bedroom until fifteen, and that he swung a sword for only one *month*.
So Ian says he will teach Airen himself, but first, a good swordsman never says *sorry*.
Airen wanders off dazed, and Ian mutters that this boy moves like someone invisible is *guiding* him.
Meanwhile Judith catches him doing push-ups again, and finally says *thank you*.
She swears to repay him, calls herself his big sister, and drags him into eating every meal *together*.
Even Lloyd notices that Airen and Illia stopped *talking*.
Then sword training starts. Judith swings first, and her balance never *breaks*.
Airen walks past the little swords and grabs the *biggest* sword on the rack.
He swings, the air roars, and the trainees laugh at the show-off *beginner*.
Then Lloyd marches over and challenges Airen to a *duel*.
Airen accepts. Ahmed yells that it's against the rules, but Ian *allows* it.
The duel begins, and Lloyd rushes in so fast Airen barely *blocks*.
Judith grits her teeth, because Lloyd is only *testing* him.
Lloyd isn't impressed, because Airen's posture is awful. So he goes for raw *power*.
Then Airen lifts the big sword and drops a vertical slash, and the blades *clash*.
Lloyd's blade stops at his throat, and the duel is *over*. Still, a month with a sword is wild.
Then the classes are read out. Illia, Lloyd and Judith all land in Class A, and Airen lands in Class *F*.
Judith rants about that arrogant Lloyd, then blushes, panics, and *punches* Airen. Classic tsundere.
That night Lloyd can't sleep, because he keeps replaying that vertical *slash*.
In Class F, Ron Tarhall asks Airen what he is missing. Airen says effort, but Ron says it's *talent*.
Then Ron makes a bet. Master the basic sword skills in a week, and Airen moves up to Class *C*.
So Airen swings all day, every day, until even Ron admits he never improved this *fast*.
On the last day Judith watches his swing and gives him a thumbs up, and Airen is *promoted* to Class C.
At lunch Judith inhales a mountain of food, and Lloyd's friends call her a hippo. She asks the loudest guy if he has a *crush*.
Judith asks if Airen and Illia had a fight. Illia is still number one, and rumor says she trains alone every *night*.
So Judith spars with him, and Airen eats her storm of attacks. Then he throws his vertical slash, and her eyes *pop*.
She grins that he's improved, but he's not at her level *yet*. And it's dark, so Illia is probably training *alone*.
So Airen sneaks into the training hall and finds Illia swinging her blade. She glares, and he waves like an *idiot*.
He gives her a gift from his little sister, and says letters were *easier* than talking.
Illia stays quiet, so Airen apologizes and leaves. That night she reads the letter and calls it *childish*.
Then she pulls out the bracelet, her hand starts to shake, and she whispers one word, *Adonis*.
She stares out the window, wondering if she's been way too *sensitive*.
The next day Lloyd marches over, and shocks everyone by asking Airen to teach him how to *concentrate*.
Judith smells a trick, and Lloyd happily admits he's *using* him.
Airen asks what he could possibly teach Lloyd. Lloyd says they train the same hours, but Airen never loses *focus*.
Airen says he's not sure how he does it. Lloyd tells him to stop putting himself down, because he's a noble and should act *proud*.
Then Lloyd grabs Airen's hands and shows him how to swing. Judith sulks, and Lloyd bets her stubbornness lasts a *week*.
Illia walks up with her tray and thanks Airen for the letter. Judith nearly chokes, and Airen yells it's *nothing* like that.
That night Airen falls asleep wondering how to sharpen his focus even more, and the dream swordsman is *waiting*.
He wakes up shaking in the dead of night, grabs his sword, and swings until he drops onto a *bench*.
Lloyd says that sounds like meditation, so he lies down on the bench, and is out in *seconds*. Judith catches him drooling.
Lloyd swears he was meditating and that his posture was the *problem*. Judith calls him a moron.
Meanwhile the instructor tells Ian that Airen got promoted to Class B, and that Brett Lloyd is making small, real *changes*.
One lazy lord just started a wave, and now the whole academy sits in rows, *meditating*. What happens next?
